def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    # Validate input arrays
    for mat, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
                      (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
                      (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if mat.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D array")
        if mat.shape != logp_with_result.shape:
            raise ValueError(f"Shape mismatch: {name} shape {mat.shape} != {logp_with_result.shape}")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(mat)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(mat > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values (must be nonpositive)")
    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    # Compute normalized future-token weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    # Compute weighted losses (negative weighted log probability)
    L_plus = -np.sum(weights[None, :] * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(weights[None, :] * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(weights[None, :] * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    # Margin
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    # Keep if margin >= tau_filter
    keep = margins >= tau_filter
    return keep, margins
